rotated_from.description: The key this one replaced, when it was issued by a rotation.

replaced_by.description: The key that replaced this one; until the overlap ends both work.

client_origin.description: Where callers reach the gateway: a canonical HTTPS origin. Null for a gateway the node's agent runs until it activates the gateway with the origin its node declares.

delivery.description: agent: the node's agent runs the gateway, with a credential it generated on the node (ADR 0052). manual: an administrator placed the credential shown once at registration.

delivery_state.description: How far the agent got with the gateway. Null for a manual gateway.

delivery_error_code.description: Why the agent's last start or stop failed; GATEWAY_TASK_EXPIRED when its task ended without a result.

certificate_not_after.description: When the serving certificate issued at activation expires.

capabilities.description: Verified capabilities of the alias's current target. Omitted when exact evidence is unavailable.

text_generation_verified.description: True only after the exact current deployment has passed generation verification; it does not advertise enabled gateway adapters.

context_token_ceiling.description: Upper bound on context tokens from the verified model, serving recipe and gateway policy. The live tokenizer may enforce a smaller limit.

client_origin.description: Where callers reach a gateway an administrator runs; required then. Omitted when the node's agent runs the gateway: the node declares its origin.

RotateDistributionKey.description: Replace a key's secret. The successor keeps the workspace, alias, label and owner; the old key stops after the overlap, or at once when it is 0.
